_doc: D5 (sprint 3): the door's names, old -> new, as data. Renamed AT ONCE, no aliases, no redirects (owner, MCQ 2026-10-01; MCP.md §5, §7). tools: every MCP tool of the head before D5 (9e97db345); verdict same | renamed | folds (into a new name: `how` says how its job is reached there) | goes (`why`: what replaces the need, or nothing) | rest-only (no tool; its REST door stays for its button). rest: every REST row that changes (a row not listed keeps its address). resources: the brain:// URIs that change. errors: refusal codes that change. tools/release-note.mjs writes the release note from this file; tools/check-vocab-selftest.mjs bans every old name it lists; tools/authority-table.mjs diffs the authority table by it. `through` (a fold into a write tool): the call is gated by that one first (a write tool files only what a preview of the caller checked). `readableBefore`: the same data was already served at that address's auth before the rename (the authority table compares with it).

words.the: a CONTRIBUTION (verb: file), a knowledge item, a check and its grade, a question and its ruling, a version, an open item
words.also: the old tool names themselves (pack_*, eagle_*, *_transmission, *_knowledge, ...) are banned as names on every face the vocabulary check scans

tools.how: updates answers what changed for you since you were last here and what waits on you (open items, the owner's blockers), with the project's picture state gave and your own items thread gave
the project's picture (its aim, as-of, blockers, your projects, the active one) is part of updates; full:true's list is `missing`
your own items (what you filed, asked, answered and reported, each with where it stands) are updates' `yours`
your open items are updates' waitingOnYou.openItems
open_items {title, ref?} opens one, {close: id} closes one; it answers your open items

tools.why: kept: its open items are read by updates and Home's count, its card answers by Decisions, its summary by updates' `yours`
split by what the write does (sprint 19): file_contribution files a preview's contributions, save_knowledge its knowledge upserts, remove_knowledge its knowledge removes

tools.how: preview {project, items: [{kind, op, data}, ...]} then save_knowledge {previewId, items} (the upserts) and remove_knowledge (the removes): each part lands all or nothing
preview {project, items: [{contribution: {lane, what, why, ...}}]} then file_contribution
a ruling, a correction or a drift is a contribution: preview then file_contribution (ruled by the plan's laws, HANDOFF D6)
read {kind} lists a kind (a page of it, `after` for the next); read {ref} or {kind, ref} reads one item
brief with no `for` answers your own role's brief (the doc capsules/<role>.md the project holds); brief {role} names another's, under the doc's own visibility
brief {for: <ref>}
read {kind: "doc"} lists the project's docs you may read
read {ref: "doc/<path>"}; doc/start-here.md always answers (the project's own, else the built-in guide)
build lists the project's contributions as the Build tab does; read {kind: "contribution"} pages them all
read {ref: "T-YYYYMMDD-NNN"} (with its grade and links)
goals {ref} answers one goal, as decisions {qid} answers one question

tools.why: every question on decisions carries its answers and its ruling; the owner's org-wide answer dump has no screen

tools.how: map {plane} (arch, data, api, mcp, flows, deps; arch when left out)
map {ref} (and gap) answers one node, as the Map's inspector shows it
map {plane: "screens"} (and surface) answers the Screens view
read_file with no id lists the files you may read (q, group, limit)

tools.why: POST /rank stays for Build's Rank button (HANDOFF D6, decided by the plan's laws)
POST /round stays for Decisions' Add to round button

tools.how: read {kind: "card_kind"}
read {ref: "card/<kind>/<id>"}
search {q, kinds: ["card"]}
read {kind: "check"}, or read {ref: "check/<id>"}
decisions
changes
read {kind: "card", cardKind: "claim"}; impact {ref} for what a ref reaches

impact {refs} answers `history`: the project's contributions that named those refs, newest first (at most 50; "screen:home" and "home" read the same; a goal by its goalRef too; a non-owner only what they may open). The history is now one project's (it was the org's).
changes {since}

tools.why: nothing files a critique any more; a challenge is a contribution, read with read and changes
the reports a wrap_up files show on updates' `yours` and in Activity; the owner's raw R2 list has no screen

rest.why: the page says What is missing; the twin of missing
state folds into updates; both doors scope the project through the one function (Part 4 b)
the tab says GTM; the twin of gtm
record_event folds into file; ask keeps a REST twin of its own
the Build tab lists the contributions; GET /read?kind=contribution pages them
preview then save_knowledge (the removes: remove_knowledge, POST /preview/remove-knowledge)
GET /brief (your own) or GET /brief?role=<role>: the doc capsules/<role>.md under its visibility, which GET /doc/:path already served to any signed-in reader (auth reader)

rest.how: GET /impact?refs=<ref>[&eval=1] answers history:{refs, count, items, more}

resources.why: a role's brief is brief {role}; its doc reads at brain://doc/capsules/<role>.md

keep.addresses: POST /artifact, GET /artifact/:id and GET /artifacts keep their addresses (save_file and read_file's twins): a saved file's link is cited inside filed proof, and an address change would break proof already filed.
keep.internal: Not renamed (internal, never read by a client or a person): the tables transmission, loops, handoff events and their columns; file names (src/transmission.js, src/handoff.js, src/holes.js, txpage.js ...); function names; the org setting handoffRepo; R2 keys inbox/handoffs/; the brain:// scheme; the ref grammar's T-YYYYMMDD-NNN id.

fields.why: the open items of the checklist
the sprint-1 piece name an item maps onto

asOf (when the project's knowledge last changed)

fields.where: wrap_up: the GitHub issue it may open

fields.new: {opened, title, ref, openItems} / {closed, openItems}: the caller's open items ride every answer

fields.old: the doc's markdown as a bare string
